results.question: What are employee benefits?
results.sources_preview: All full-time employees are eligible for health insurance, dental coverage, and vision plans after 30 days of employment. The company contributes 80% of premium costs for employee coverage. Paid time off includes 15 vacation days per year, 10 sick days, and recognized public holidays. Employees may also participate in a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching up to 4% of salary.

results.question: How many vacation days do employees receive?
results.sources_preview: Paid time off includes 15 vacation days per year, 10 sick days, and recognized public holidays.

results.question: Is remote work allowed?
results.sources_preview: Flexible working arrangements, including remote work up to two days per week, may be approved by department managers.
